answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 1005 Country: IQ Title: Right now i am working in Iraq an American base for catering company.my question is, the money which i am earning is it Halal. Second i have to support a large number of family members and my intension is earning for them. so is my money will be Halal? Question: Assalam Alaykum I would like to thanks the Ulamas of Deoband that they are sloving and serving the valuable answers of the worldwide questioners. Right now i am working in Iraq an American base for catering company.my question is, the money which i am earning is it Halal. Second i have to support a large number of family members and my intension is earning for them. so is my money will be Halal? Answer ID: 1005 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1037=768/H) If your work is right and Halal then your earning is also Halal , it will not be regarded as Haram . But, if your work involves anything unlawful then the ruling will also be different. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
